trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: Customer states intent to return an order and expresses time pressure.
steps.text: Hello, I have very less time, meeting start होणार आहे. माझा एक order return करायचा आहे.

steps.purpose: Agent acknowledges and asks for order ID.
steps.text: नमस्कार. मी नक्की मदत करेन. तुमचा order ID सांगू शकता का?
हो, order ID आहे ORD-40002. लवकर करा please, वेळ नाहीये माझ्याकडे.

steps.purpose: Agent asks for registered name to verify identity.
steps.text: धन्यवाद. Security साठी मला तुमचं registered name verify करावं लागेल. नाव सांगू शकता का?
Ramesh. फटाफट करा.

steps.purpose: Agent informs of need for more factors and asks for date of birth.
steps.text: धन्यवाद Ramesh जी. Security साठी मला अजून एक detail verify करावी लागेल. तुमची date of birth सांगू शकता का?
अरे यार, किती time घेता तुम्ही. 12 May आहे.

steps.purpose: Verify identity with name and DOB.
Agent asks for pincode to complete verification.
steps.text: धन्यवाद. Verification पूर्ण करण्यासाठी मला तुमचा registered pincode पण लागेल. तो सांगू शकता का?
Pincode 411038 आहे. आता लवकर पुढे सांगा.

steps.purpose: Verify identity with name, DOB, and pincode.
Agent confirms verification and asks for return reason.
steps.text: धन्यवाद, verification झालं आहे. तुम्हाला हे order का return करायचं आहे? कारण मला system मध्ये reason टाकावा लागतो.
मला ते shoes नको आहेत आता. I just changed my mind. दुसरे घेतले मी.

steps.purpose: Agent explains that the return window has elapsed.
steps.text: Ramesh जी, मी check केलं. Return window 7 दिवसांची होती, पण आता 21 दिवस झाले आहेत. त्यामुळे हे return eligible नाहीये.

steps.purpose: Customer asks if claiming it is defective would make it eligible.
steps.text: अरे पण मला ते use नाही करायचे. जर मी म्हटलं की ते defective आहेत तर return घ्याल का? लवकर सांगा.

steps.purpose: Agent agrees to check policy for defective items.
steps.text: मी defective item साठी policy check करते, एक minute द्या.

steps.purpose: Agent explains that defective items also have the same window.
steps.text: Defective reason साठी पण window 7 दिवसांची आहे. 21 दिवस झाल्यामुळे मी हे return process नाही करू शकत.

steps.purpose: Customer insists on return and refund.
steps.text: काहीही करून return घ्या ना. मला refund हवा आहे.

steps.purpose: Agent firmly denies the request based on policy.
steps.text: मला समजू शकतं तुमचा त्रास, पण system मध्ये return window close झाली आहे. Refund possible नाहीये.
हे खूप बेकार आहे. तुमची service चांगली नाहीये.
माफ करा Ramesh जी. Policy प्रमाणे 7 दिवसानंतर return घेता येत नाही.

steps.purpose: Customer abruptly ends the call due to time pressure.
steps.text: ठीक आहे, ठेवा phone, माझी meeting चालू झाली आहे.
Call केल्याबद्दल धन्यवाद. तुमचा दिवस शुभ जावो.

ir.terminal_condition: Customer informed about the ineligibility due to elapsed window.

issues.detail: The factors_matched count in the verify_customer_identity tool results is mathematically impossible. It goes from 0 (e7) to 1 (e11) to 3 (e15) despite the user not correcting the initially failed name factor. If the first factor failed, adding two more factors can yield at most 2 matches, not 3.
issues.repair_instruction: Regenerate from e7 onwards, ensuring the factors_matched count increments logically (e.g., 1 at e7, 2 at e11, 3 at e15). Additionally, correct the grammatical error in the user's utterance at e17 from 'दुसरे भेटले मी' to 'दुसरे मिळाले मला' or 'दुसरे घेतले मी'.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully demonstrates both target variants by avoiding partial invocation and strictly grounding the policy explanation in the tool outputs. However, there is a logical inconsistency in the mock tool results for identity verification, where the number of matched factors jumps impossibly. A suffix repair is needed to correct this numerical progression and to fix a minor Marathi grammatical error in e17.

variant_findings.reason: The agent needs to call the check_return_eligibility tool but lacks the mandatory 'reason' argument. In e16, the agent explicitly asks the customer for the reason, obtains it in e17, and only then invokes the tool in e18, perfectly fulfilling the partial invocation prevention requirement.

variant_findings.reason: The agent grounds their response entirely on the tool output. In e20 and e25, the agent states the exact window (7 days) and elapsed days (21 days) returned by the tool in e19 and e24, without adding any unsupported claims or guarantees.
